3499-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

971-4687-6006.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-4687-6006.description:
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

339-677-728-4742.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1170-4030-5131-5226--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4030-5131-5226--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Starnheim Courser.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1170-1594-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1594-3698-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

751-1741-2906-5778.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
751-1741-2906-5778.description:
Cast Cloud of Faeries with offspring by paying {1}{U} using the cost reduction from Rakdos.
When Cloud of Faeries enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries abilities, untapping two lands.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Cloud of Faeries.
When the token copy of Cloud of Faeries enters, its ability triggers, untapping two lands.
Activate four lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake with offspring by paying {U}, using cost reduction from Rakdos.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning the nontoken Cloud of Faeries to its owner's hand.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Shrieking Drake.
When the token copy of Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers, returning the nontoken Shrieking Drake to its owner's hand.
Repeat.
751-1741-2906-5778.notes: Once infinite mana has been generated, the Shrieking Drake can return any creature other than Zinnia to hand to recast infinitely.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a type chosen that matches a type of the persist creature

345-2438--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

240-2921-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

560-2558-4779-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
When the Soldier enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

997-6351-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1495-4613-6843-7061.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Solid Ground.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2018-2281-4053.description:
Activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it.
When Saffi Eriksdotter dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Saffi Eriksdotter from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Saffi Eriksdotter ability.
Repeat.

880-2692-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2692-6664.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

465-803-3742-4251-6633.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-803-3742-4251-6633.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

643-1789-3967-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4091-5640.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
4091-5640.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Ertha Jo's second ability triggers, copying Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting any other creature or artifact.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and the other targeted creature or artifact.
Repeat.

369-1258-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake, adding one mana of any color.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Abduction triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Repeat.

2113-2713-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Gilder Bairn.
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2113-2713-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Tolvada // The Broken Sky

2292-2650-2781.description:
Cast Invasion of Tolvada by paying {3}{W}{B}.
When Invasion of Tolvada enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Invasion of Tolvada.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Invasion of Tolvada.
Repeat from step 2.

3899-4772-4871.notablePrerequisites: Spawning Pit has at least two charge counters.
3899-4772-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two 2/2 Spawn artifact creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing a Spawn.
The Spawn dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

262-4222-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Freed from the Real attached to the same creature.
The creature with Freed from the Real and Elemental Mastery attached has a power of at least two and does not have summoning sickness.
262-4222-4289.description:
Activate the creature with Freed from the Real and Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate an Elemental token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

298-4499-4772-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Angelic Quartermaster.
Angelic Quartermaster enters the battlefield, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and any other creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be used to activate abilities.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-4772.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-4772.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

813-2104-2628.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cycle the instant/sorcery each turn
813-2104-2628.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant and/or sorcery card in hand with cycling.
813-2104-2628.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate any instant/sorcery card in your hand's cycling ability by paying its cycling cost and discarding it.
Escape Protocol triggers, causing you to pay {1} to blink Scholar of the Ages.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation and the card with cycling from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat each turn.
